dialogue.user: Hi there! I'm looking for a pair of outdoor shoes. Do you have any recommendations within my budget of $100 to $200?
dialogue.agent:
Here are some great outdoor shoes within your budget of $100 to $200:

1. **ROCKROOSTER Bedrock - Mens Urban Waterproof Anti-Fatigue Outdoor Hiking Boots**
   - Price: $109.99

products.title: Tommaso Pista Knit Women's Cycling Shoe and Cleat Bundle, Indoor Cycling Class Ready Shoes with Compatible Cleat, Look Delta, SPD - Black, Pink, Grey, Blue
products.description: Listen up, fitness fanatics! If you want to be the envy of all your spinning pals, you need the Tommaso Pista Aria Indoor Cycling Shoes with pre-installed SPD Cleats. These work perfectly with the Echelon Bike, Equinox bikes, Soulcycle, Cyclber, Crunch Fitnees, 24 Hour Fitness, and many more. Not only are they stylish, but they are the only cycling shoes that come equipped with Pre-Installed SPD cleats. That means that these shoes are ready to go right out of the box, so you can power through your indoor cycling challenges like a boss. The ultra-breathable knit upper keeps your feet cool, even when you're sweating like a sinner in church. The soles are super stiff too, so you don't feel pressure from the pedals, while ensuring that you are getting the maximum power transfer out of every pedal stroke. With the classic and reliable traditional lace up closure, you'll always have a secure fit, that eliminates pressure points and hot spots - and trust us, you'll love these puppies when you're huffing and puffing your way up those virtual hills. Need wide cycling shoes? Laces are the only way to ensure that all feet types are treated equally, allowing maximum adjustability and comfort. But wait, there's more! The Pista Aria is built for the most demanding cyclists - that means you! The lightweight carbon infused nylon sole will keep performing year after year, while the reinforced toe and heel will protect you precious feet from bumbs. Did we mention that these are the only cycling shoes that come with a LIFEIMTE WARRANTY against any defects. Just remember, you get what you pay for, so skip the cheap knockoff shoes and get the real thing, your feet and body will thank you for the investment.
